evals.prompt: Make me the fold-in-half court sheet for today that I can print and take to court.
evals.expected_output: A print-ready 8.5x11 PDF whose readable content sits in a 4.25" column (fold-in-half-lengthwise layout), one card per court event with the next date/time in that room, the next date/time at that courthouse, a balance line only on criminal/DUI/traffic/license matters, and ruled note lines under each event.

evals.prompt: I've got the docket in this JSON already — just render the folded daily court calendar PDF from it.
